initialization: Original five-language XLM-R pilot, before RU/EN-only CC adaptation; known generator provenance only

test_cohorts.DetectRL-X_SEO: 250 parents per language/generator, DeepSeek-V3 and Gemini-2.5-Flash; unseen collection and families relative to XLM-R training
test_cohorts.MAiDE-up: All five-language reviews in the published file; new Booking corpus and GPT-4 checkpoint, same broader GPT family as training GPT-4o

external_selection: No detector scores; remove exact and char3-5 cosine>=.90 development/previous-control overlap, exclude paired SEO parent, retain one same-label internal duplicate
checkpoint: Max minimum-language standardized partial ROC-AUC at FPR .05 on validation; ties macro mean then earlier epoch; epoch0 comparator cannot win new model selection
document_score: Mean raw AI-minus-human logits over all balanced non-overlapping windows of 382+2 tokens, no inference truncation
calibration: Separate human parents; fixed 40% deterministic short-view augmentation; per-language one-sided95% binomial upper FPR bound .05; all thresholds frozen before test inference
metrics: Recall, actual FPR, ROC-AUC, trapezoidal PR-AUC, AP per language and external corpus separately; min12letters refusals retained
